name: Get Session Info (SA)
help: Retrieve detailed logon session information for the current process token
long_help: Uses LsaGetLogonSessionData to display comprehensive information about the current logon session including: username, domain, authentication package (NTLM/Kerberos), logon type (Interactive/Network/Service/etc.), session ID, logon server, DNS domain, UPN, profile path, home directory, and password timestamps (last changed, can change, must change).
